A1.justification: Both complete, readable 28-page PDFs describe PhysGM and PhysAssets. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A-F support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original simulation comparisons, GSO reconstruction results, a user study, DPO ablations, and qualitative experiments in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and adds qualitative baseline comparisons in Figure 7.

M1.justification: The transformer architecture, Gaussian and physics prediction heads, MPM simulation, auxiliary-view generation, and two-stage supervised/DPO training remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same PhysAssets training collection, 1,009-object GSO test set, and physical interaction scenarios. Figure 7 adds examples within existing material and simulation coverage.

E2.justification: The comparator sets in the quantitative experiments and appendix user-study description are unchanged. Figure 7 visualizes the existing OmniPhysGS and DreamPhysics comparison; the newly cited DGS-LRM and 4DGT are not evaluated.

E3.justification: No previously stated split, metric, training budget, or testing procedure is revised. Section 4.2 newly specifies four-view inputs and baseline initialization, but the PDFs do not establish that these settings changed or experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Figure 7 adds a focused qualitative case comparison on cake and fire-hydrant examples, showing deformation differences between PhysGM and two baselines. Existing DPO ablations, prompt analyses, and appendix robustness studies remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including the user-study filtering to 100 valid participants and UPR calculation. No new seed information, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests appear.

E6.justification: Figure 7 adds qualitative result entries for PhysGM, OmniPhysGS, and DreamPhysics on two examples. Numerical tables are unchanged, including PhysGM's average CLIP similarity of 0.2748 and UPR of 42.8% in Table 1.

T1.justification: Equations 1-18 and their mathematical content are retained, including the DPO objective, MPM updates, constitutive models, and trajectory-alignment definitions. No proofs or formal assumptions are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about rapid feed-forward physical 4D synthesis, joint geometry/physics prediction, DPO refinement, and the PhysAssets contribution.

C2.justification: The rewritten comparison paragraph retains the same interpretation of physical priors and the quality-speed trade-off. Discussions of DPO, simulation cost, the sim-to-real gap, generalization, and uniform material assumptions are unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 4.2 newly documents four-view inputs, initialization of baselines with PhysGM-generated Gaussian splats, and consistent physical parameters except those each baseline optimizes. These disclosures improve reproducibility information without establishing a procedural change.

R1.justification: v3 adds citations to 4DGT in Section 2.1 and DGS-LRM in Section 2.2, with corresponding bibliography entries. The surrounding research positioning remains substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: Changes comprise a localized rewrite of Section 4.2, minor text corrections, a project-leader author footnote, and a shortened affiliation. The overall section and appendix structure is retained.

P2.justification: v3 adds Figure 7, moves Table 2 within page 8, and moves Table 3 to page 9. Existing appendix Figures 7-16 become Figures 8-17 with their visual content retained.

improvement.justification: The added comparison-setting details in Section 4.2 make initialization and experimental controls more assessable, while Figure 7 supplies direct visual comparisons missing from v2. These are useful but limited gains; the quantitative evidence, substantive ablations, and stated limitations remain unchanged.
